name: @tomsun28/pizza
description: Pizza - Pizza is an event-driven agent. Every conversation, tool call, and file edit is an event in an immutable log. Your UI, the LLM context, and the session tree are all projections of that log.

scripts.clean: shx rm -rf dist && npm run clean -w @tomsun28/pizza-protocol
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/src/cli.js && shx cp package.json README.md dist/ && npm run generate-providers && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run vendor-tools
scripts.build:binary: npm run build && npm run vendor-tools && bun build --compile ./dist/src/bun/cli.js --outfile dist/pizza && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:binary && npm run prepare-desktop-vendor && cd apps/desktop && cargo tauri build
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run fix:pty-permissions && npm run prepare-desktop-resources && npm run prepare-desktop-vendor && cd apps/desktop && cargo tauri dev
scripts.prepare-desktop-resources: shx mkdir -p dist/theme dist/assets dist/export-html dist/builtin-skills && shx touch dist/pizza dist/pizza.exe dist/photon_rs_bg.wasm && shx cp package.json dist/ && shx touch dist/providers.json && node -e "const p=require('process'),fs=require('fs');const k=p.platform+'-'+p.arch;fs.mkdirSync('apps/desktop/vendor-bin/'+k,{recursive:true});for(const t of ['fd','rg'])fs.writeFileSync('apps/desktop/vendor-bin/'+k+'/'+t+(p.platform==='win32'?'.exe':''),'');fs.mkdirSync('apps/desktop/prebuilds-bin/'+k,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('apps/desktop/prebuilds-bin/'+k+'/.placeholder','')"
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/packages/tui/theme && shx cp packages/tui/theme/*.json dist/packages/tui/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/packages/tui/assets && shx cp packages/tui/assets/*.png dist/packages/tui/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/src/core/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/src/core/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/src/core/export-html/vendor/ && shx mkdir -p dist/src/builtin-skills && shx cp -r src/builtin-skills/* dist/src/builtin-skills/ && shx rm -f dist/src/builtin-skills/index.ts && shx mkdir -p dist/src/builtin-extensions/computer-use/backend/platform/macos && shx cp src/builtin-extensions/computer-use/backend/platform/macos/helper-path.mjs dist/src/builtin-extensions/computer-use/backend/platform/macos/helper-path.mjs
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/; fi && shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp packages/tui/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/assets && shx cp packages/tui/assets/*.png dist/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && shx mkdir -p dist/builtin-skills && shx cp -r src/builtin-skills/* dist/builtin-skills/ && shx rm -f dist/builtin-skills/index.ts && if [ -d docs ]; then shx cp -r docs dist/; fi && if [ -d examples ]; then shx cp -r examples dist/; fi && shx cp node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/prebuilds && shx cp -r node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds dist/prebuilds
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run vendor-tools

author: Z.ai
